title: Missing Debug impl on public fragmentation types
description:
Locations:
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/no_ack.rs line 29: `NoAckSender`
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/no_ack.rs line 135: `NoAckSenderIter`  
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/no_ack.rs line 180: `NoAckReceiver`
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_always.rs line 41: `Sender`
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_always.rs line 294: `Receiver`

These public types have no Debug implementation. Note that `AckOnErrorSender` and `AckOnErrorReceiver` correctly have manual Debug impls (they omit large fields like payload).

What goes wrong: Users cannot use these types with {:?} formatting, dbg!(), or derive Debug on types that contain them. This hinders debugging and is inconsistent with other types in the crate.

Fix: Add `#[derive(Debug)]` or implement Debug manually if some fields (like `packet: [u8; MAX_PACKET_SIZE]`) should be summarized rather than printed in full.
